Package index

Decomposition

The entry point, and the bootstrap intervals that say whether the masking gap is distinguishable from zero.

decompose_cindex() print(<cindex_decomp>) summary(<cindex_decomp>) as.data.frame(<cindex_decomp>)
Decompose a concordance index into Event-Event and Event-Censored parts
confint(<cindex_decomp>)
Bootstrap confidence intervals for a concordance decomposition

Weightings

A concordance index is fully determined by its pair weighting. These constructors supply it.

weights_harrell() weights_uno() weights_truncated() weights_custom()
Pair weightings for concordance decomposition

Censoring and comparison

Trace the decomposition as censoring rises, or run several models over one cohort.

censoring_curve() print(<cindex_curve>) as.data.frame(<cindex_curve>)
Trace the decomposition as administrative censoring increases
compare_decompositions() print(<cindex_comparison>) as.data.frame(<cindex_comparison>)
Compare the decomposition across several models

Plotting

autoplot(<cindex_comparison>) autoplot(<cindex_decomp>) autoplot(<cindex_curve>)
Plot a concordance decomposition
theme_cindex()
Plot theme for cindexdecomp
